description: This file defines the AzureQueueAdapter class, which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for Azure Queue storage within the Orleans streaming framework. It manages queue creation, message batching, and stream-to-queue mapping.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapter
classes.description: Implements the IQueueAdapter interface for Azure Queue storage, managing message batching and queue creation.

methods.name: AzureQueueAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AzureQueueAdapter with necessary dependencies and configuration.

methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specific queue based on QueueId.

methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of messages into the appropriate Azure Queue, handling queue initialization if necessary.
